title: AI Toolkit | Splunk
content:
## Run custom AI on the data that runs your business. No data movement, no separate stack.  

![Build agents on Splunk](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/icons/new-standard/icon-learning-management-color-k.svg) ![Build agents on Splunk](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/icons/new-standard/icon-learning-management-color-k.svg)

### Build agents on Splunk

Easily build and deploy governed, auditable agents. Splunk data and tools are accessible to agents through integration with knowledge bases, Splunk MCP server, and external MCP integrations.

[See Agent Launchpad](/en_us/products/agent-launchpad.html)

![Run GenAI inside Splunk ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/full-featured-log-search-and-analysis-color-k.svg) ![Run GenAI inside Splunk ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/full-featured-log-search-and-analysis-color-k.svg)

### Run GenAI inside Splunk

Run Splunk hosted models like Foundation AI Security, Cisco Deep Time Series, and GPT-OSS natively in Splunk – no GPUs, no API keys, no data egress. Use third-party frontier models or self-host via Ollama.

![machine-learning](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/infrastructure-monitoring-and-troubleshooting-color-k.svg) ![machine-learning](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/infrastructure-monitoring-and-troubleshooting-color-k.svg)

### Run ML on your data

Accelerate development with hundreds of built-in ML templates or your custom models via ONNX and AWS SageMaker. Guided assistants simplify forecasting, outlier detection, clustering, and prediction for all users. Smart Assistants guide non-data-scientists through forecasting, outlier detection, clustering, and prediction.

[Explore more ML](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-cloud-platform/apply-machine-learning)

See how customers are using the AI Toolkit!

Features

## **Everything you need to build custom AI on Splunk** 

Save time using pre-built components.  

![Agent Launchpad](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/customer-support.svg) ![Agent Launchpad](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/customer-support.svg)

### Agent Launchpad

Use [Agent Launchpad](/en_us/products/agent-launchpad.html) to create, test, and deploy RBAC-governed, auditable agents that use Splunk data and tools. Agents reason with hosted models, ground decision in RAG and knowledge bases, and act through Splunk and external MCP integrations. 

![Hosted Foundation Models](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/managing-cloud-and-hybrid-environments-color-k.svg) ![Hosted Foundation Models](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/managing-cloud-and-hybrid-environments-color-k.svg)

### Hosted Foundation Models

Generative AI models are hosted natively inside the Splunk Platform boundary. Use Foundation-Sec for security, Cisco Deep Time Series Model for forecasting and anomaly detection, GPT-OSS for general reasoning. No GPUs, no API keys, no data movement required. 

![External LLM Model Integration ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/machine-learning-color-k.svg) ![External LLM Model Integration ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/machine-learning-color-k.svg)

### External LLM Model Integration

Integrate any model, from frontier LLMs to custom ONNX and Amazon SageMaker builds, directly with Splunk Platform data. Use the AI Toolkit and DSDL as your inference and orchestration surface to keep existing model investments portable and scalable. 

![Custom ML Models ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/splunk-ai.svg) ![Custom ML Models ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/splunk-ai.svg)

### Custom ML Models

Build custom ML models using hundreds of built-in algorithms with guided and code-first workflows and multivariate support. Smart Assistants guide you through forecasting, outliers, clustering, and prediction.  

![Run ML and GenAI from SPL ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/delivers-context-for-incident-prioritization-color-k.svg) ![Run ML and GenAI from SPL ](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/standard/delivers-context-for-incident-prioritization-color-k.svg)

### Run ML and GenAI from SPL

Your models become first-class search commands across Splunk Cloud and Enterprise, and your existing dashboards, alerts, and reports continue to work unchanged. 

Product Capabilities

Apply AI to your data for faster insights to make more informed decisions  

Spot the red flags with anomaly detection

Through intensive training, AI and machine learning establish baselines for your data and detect deviations from past behavior or atypicalities that might otherwise go undetected. See how the National Ignition Facility identifies atypical behavior as it monitors the U.S. nuclear stockpile.

 ![machine-learning-toolkit](/content/dam/splunk2/images/screenshots/conf19/mltk/desktop-screenshot-mltk-dashboard.jpg)

### See the unseen in your data with clustering

There are patterns in your data that human analysts will miss: trends in ITOps and in security, and patterns in customer behaviors that suggest new markets and opportunities. Automate analysis of clusters to identify and group similar data points to help you see the signals in the noise, and make better decisions. See how pharma startup Recursion identifies high-value patterns in large sets of genetic research data.

 ![actionable-itteligence](/content/dam/splunk2/images/screenshots/platform-journey/Actionable%20Intelligence.png)

Get started with AI Toolkit
